_about: Device table compiled into PeatsAudio 1.9.45 (Android), plus what the app's code says about each model. Newer models, including the H3 and Air5 Pro+, are not in the APK: the app downloads their entries at runtime. Add them here as they are confirmed on hardware. Entries with a `reports` field come from hardware, not the APK; the reports are in data/soundpeats/reports/. Names and rules marked SOUNDPEATS 2.5.3 come from that app, PeatsAudio's successor from the same company, which downloads its model data too.

_fields.family: The app's chip family code. It decides the EQ command, the EQ merge rule, BLE framing and the firmware-update path.
_fields.old_eq_protocol: The flag compiled into the app for this code. null means the code is not in that enum. Use eq_command, which applies the app's full rule.
_fields.transport: spp: the common frame protocol in docs/soundpeats/PROTOCOL.md sections 1 to 4. qcy_ble: QCY's protocol, section 10.
_fields.eq_command: EQ band command under vendor 001D. The app uses 0E01 for every Qualcomm model whatever the flag says, and for any code whose flag is true. Everything else gets 0E02.
_fields.eq_merge: onto_classic_bands: user points are snapped onto the model's classic curve and gains added. append_after_classic: the classic bands are sent, then the user's bands.
_fields.custom_eq_bands: Bands on the app's custom EQ screen: 10 (31 Hz to 16 kHz) or 8 on Bluetrum (62 Hz to 8 kHz).
_fields.family_sources.marketed_chip: The chip the model is sold with.
_fields.family_sources.ble_device_information: The manufacturer and model the earbuds report in the standard BLE Device Information service.
_fields.reports: Probe and capture reports from real earbuds, under data/soundpeats/reports/.
_fields.ldac_excludes: Features the official app offers only while LDAC is off, as the owner saw in PeatsAudio. Ids are from data/soundpeats/commands.json.
_fields.ldac_or_multipoint: LDAC and multipoint are one either-or setting on the earbuds: turning one off turns the other on. Seen on hardware.
_fields.fit_keeps_anc: The official app leaves the noise mode as it is during the fit test. On every other model it turns ANC off first (docs/soundpeats/PROTOCOL.md sections 9 and 11).
_fields.confirmed: Commands marked per_model in data/soundpeats/commands.json that the official app offers on this model, as the owner saw in PeatsAudio. Without this, the app does not offer them even if the earbuds answer the read.
_fields.eq: The EQ the official app writes to this model, read from a phone capture: one band per entry with its centre frequency, Q and the base gain the user's gain is added to; the master gain sent with every band; the range of the app's sliders. eq.presets are complete curves sent as they are, with the same master gain.
_fields.touch_disable_inverted: SOUNDPEATS 2.5.3 shows the touch-disable switch the other way round on this model: its firmware code contains one of the 17 codes in that app's list (docs/soundpeats/PROTOCOL.md section 9). Whether the earbuds' reply, the write or both are inverted was not traced, so SoundPeter does not act on it yet.

reported_chips._about: Chips named in public reviews. Not from the app and not confirmed on hardware. Use only to guess a family before a probe report exists.
